name: App Icon: FLUX Crimson Katana Strike
purpose: Primary App Icon — FLUX.1 [schnell] Dynamic Combat Pose.
description: Dynamic solid black samurai silhouette mid-draw with drawn razor-sharp katana cutting across a solid bright red sun circle.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D flat vector game logo icon. Pure solid pitch-black silhouette of a samurai ninja drawing a long curved katana sword in dynamic low combat stance. Centered inside a solid flat bright red circular sun disc (#FF2035). Pure solid pitch-black background (#000000). Duotone color palette of pure black and vibrant bright red only. Razor-sharp clean vector edges, high contrast silhouette, no 3D rendering, no human face, no text, no watermark.
